question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement** on your Fjord AWD, the service guide and parts catalog list the following. Order one of each. Sources: *voltrieve-service-guide.md* and *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*.

| Part | Article number |
|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| Front brake pad set | **VP-10254** |
| Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| Front caliper fitting kit, for one side | **VP-10709** |
| Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1-litre bottle | **VP-15168** |

The pad set covers **both front wheels**; the service guide says pads are always renewed as an axle set. The fluid is needed to bleed the circuit afterwards. (*voltrieve-service-guide.md*)

Before work under the car, the guide says to activate service mode. It also says to turn off automatic air-suspension levelling before lifting the Fjord. (*voltrieve-service-guide.md*)

question: brakes-lumen
